The investigation traced the flow of INR 4,70,000 originating from seed wallet 0xa7f39c1d8e4b2a5f7c3d9e0a1b8c6d4e5f2a67e9 on 2026‑09‑08 at 10:31:04 IST. Within three hops, 14 distinct entities were involved in 17 transfers, of which 16 are confirmed and one is an inferred correlation. The movement shows rapid automated dispersal, with the first outbound transaction occurring three minutes after receipt, interaction with a mixer contract that transferred 1,500 USDT, and subsequent exposure to a cross‑chain bridge within two downstream hops. Sixteen of the transfers meet or exceed the 30 % reporting threshold, indicating a pattern of sizable redistribution.

Risk scoring assigns a high rating of 65/100 to the seed wallet, elevated by proximity to a known scam cluster (+20), rapid automated dispersal (+15), mixer interaction (+15) and bridge exposure (+15). The highest‑scoring entity observed is 0x9c04a7e3b21d5f86c0a94e7d2b83f150c6ead21e with a critical score of 75/100, followed by the seed wallet (65/100) and 0x3f1a7d92c04e8b56af10d3e7b829c45d6e0a71bc (35/100).
